description_en: Modifies the backup policy of a MongoDB instance
name: ModifyBackupPolicy

parameters.help_en: The instance ID
parameters.help_zh: 实例ID
parameters.name: db_instance_id

parameters.help_en: The time period during which backups are performed. The format is HH:mmZ-HH:mmZ (UTC). The time period is limited to 1 hour
parameters.help_zh: 执行备份的时间，格式为HH:mmZ-HH:mmZ（UTC时间）。 时间范围限制为1小时
parameters.name: preferred_backup_time

parameters.help_en:
The backup cycle. Valid values:
Monday: Monday.
Tuesday: Tuesday.
Wednesday: Wednesday.
Thursday: Thursday.
Friday: Friday.
Saturday: Saturday.
Sunday: Sunday.

<notice>To ensure data security, back up your MongoDB data at least twice a week.</notice>

If you specify multiple values, separate them with commas (,)
parameters.help_zh:
备份周期，取值说明：
Monday：周一。
Tuesday：周二。
Wednesday：周三。
Thursday：周四。
Friday：周五。
Saturday：周六。
Sunday：周日。

<notice>为了数据安全，请一周至少备份两次MongoDB></notice>


传入多个值，请用英文逗号（,）隔开
parameters.name: preferred_backup_period

parameters.help_en:
The number of days for which full backups are retained.

For users who created instances before September 10, 2021, the default retention period is 7 days.
For new users who created instances on or after September 10, 2021, the default retention period is 30 days
parameters.help_zh:
全量备份保留天数。

2021年09月10日前用户默认保留天数为7天。
2021年09月10日后新用户默认保留天数为30天
parameters.name: backup_retention_period

parameters.help_en:
Specifies whether to enable log backup. Valid values:
0: Disables log backup. This is the default value.

1: Enables log backup.
<notice>Sharded cluster instances do not support disabling log backup.</notice>
parameters.help_zh:
是否打开日志备份，取值说明：
0：关闭（默认值）。

1：打开。
<notice>分片集群不支持关闭日志备份></notice>
parameters.name: enable_backup_log

parameters.help_en:
The number of days for which log backups are retained. Default value: 7.

Valid values: 7 to 730
parameters.help_zh:
日志备份保留天数，默认为7天。

取值范围：7~730
parameters.name: log_backup_retention_period

parameters.help_en:
The snapshot backup type. Valid values:

Flash: Backup within seconds.
Standard: Standard backup. This is the default value
parameters.help_zh:
快照备份类型，取值说明：

Flash：秒级备份。
Standard：常规备份（默认值）
parameters.name: snapshot_backup_type

parameters.help_en:
The high-frequency backup frequency. Valid values:

-1: Disables high-frequency backups.
30: Every 30 minutes.
60: Every 1 hour.
120: Every 2 hours.
180: Every 3 hours.
240: Every 4 hours.
360: Every 6 hours.
480: Every 8 hours.
720: Every 12 hours.

If SnapshotBackupType is set to Standard, this parameter must be set to -1.
If SnapshotBackupType is set to Flash and this parameter is set to a value greater than 0, high-frequency backups take effect
parameters.help_zh:
高频备份频率，取值说明：

-1：不开启高频备份。
30：每30分钟。
60：每1小时。
120：每2小时。
180：每3小时。
240：每4小时。
360：每6小时。
480：每8小时。
720：每12小时。

当SnapshotBackupType取值为Standard时，该参数取值固定为-1。
当SnapshotBackupType取值为Flash，且该参数取值大于0时，高频备份才生效
parameters.name: backup_interval

parameters.help_en: The number of days for which high-frequency backups are retained. Before you use this parameter, make sure that the BackupInterval parameter is specified. Default value: 1
parameters.help_zh: 高频备份保留天数，使用该参数前需要先确认已经传入BackupInterval字段。默认保留时长一天
parameters.name: high_frequency_backup_retention

parameters.help_en:
The backup data retention policy. Valid values:

0: Deletes all backup sets of the instance immediately when the instance is released.

1: An automatic backup is performed when the instance is released, and the backup set is retained for long-term retention (LTR).
2: An automatic backup is performed when the instance is released, and all backup sets of the cluster are retained for long-term retention (LTR).

For more information, see https://help.aliyun.com/document_detail/2779111.html
parameters.help_zh:
备份保留策略。

0：实例释放时立即删除该实例的所有备份集

1：实例释放时会自动备份，长期保留该备份集
2：实例释放时会自动备份，并长期保留该集群的所有备份集

详细信息请参见：https://help.aliyun.com/document_detail/2779111.html
parameters.name: backup_retention_policy_on_cluster_deletion

parameters.help_en:
The operation policy for cross-region backup. Valid values:

update: Modifies the cross-region backup policy.
delete: Deletes the cross-region backup policy.

This parameter is required for cross-region backup
parameters.help_zh:
异地备份操作策略：

update: 修改异地备份策略
delete: 删除异地备份策略

异地备份必填
parameters.name: cross_backup_type

parameters.help_en:
The region where the instance is deployed.


This parameter is required to recover deleted instances.
This parameter is required for cross-region backup
parameters.help_zh:
实例所在地域。


已删除实例恢复必填
异地备份必填
parameters.name: src_region

parameters.help_en:
The region where backups are stored.


This parameter is required for cross-region backup
parameters.help_zh:
备份所在地域。


异地备份必填
parameters.name: dest_region

parameters.help_en:
The retention type for cross-region backup. Valid values:

delay: Retains backups for a specified period.

never: Never expires.

This parameter is required for cross-region backup
parameters.help_zh:
异地备份保留类型。

delay（保留一段时间）

never（不过期）

异地备份必填
parameters.name: cross_retention_type

parameters.help_en:
The retention period for cross-region backup. Valid values: 3 to 1825 days.


This parameter is required for cross-region backup.
This parameter is required and must be specified when CrossRetentionType is set to delay
parameters.help_zh:
异地备份保留时长，可设置 3-1825 天。


异地备份必填
当 CrossRetentionType 为 delay 时使用且必须使用
parameters.name: cross_retention_value

parameters.help_en:
The days of the week when cross-region backup is performed. Valid values:

Monday: Monday.
Tuesday: Tuesday.
Wednesday: Wednesday.
Thursday: Thursday.
Friday: Friday.
Saturday: Saturday.
Sunday: Sunday.

This parameter is required for cross-region backup.
If you specify multiple values, separate them with commas (,).
When the backup settings are set to standard backup, the value must be a subset of the PreferredBackupPeriod backup epoch
parameters.help_zh:
异地备份的保留时间。

Monday：周一
Tuesday：周二
Wednesday：周三
Thursday：周四
Friday：周五
Saturday：周六
Sunday：周日

异地备份必填
传入多个值，请用英文逗号（,）隔开。
当备份设置为常规备份时，该值需要为 PreferredBackupPeriod 备份周期的子集
parameters.name: cross_backup_period

parameters.help_en:
Specifies whether to enable cross-region log backup.

This parameter is required for cross-region backup.
1: Enables cross-region log backup. This value is required for sharded cluster instances. For replica set instances, this value is required if you want to support cross-region point-in-time recovery.
0: Disables cross-region log backup
parameters.help_zh:
是否开启跨地域日志备份 。

异地备份必填
1： 打开  (分片集群必须为1，副本集如果想支持异地时间点恢复必须为1)
0： 关闭
parameters.name: enable_cross_log_backup

parameters.help_en:
The retention type for cross-region log backup. Valid values:

delay: Retains backups for a specified period.
never: Never expires.

This parameter is required for cross-region backup
parameters.help_zh:
异地日志备份保留类型。

delay（保留一段时间）
never（不过期）

异地备份必填
parameters.name: cross_log_retention_type

parameters.help_en:
The retention period for cross-region log backup. Valid values: 3 to 1825 days. The value must be less than or equal to the value of CrossRetentionValue.


This parameter is required for cross-region backup
parameters.help_zh:
异地日志备份保留时长，可设置 3-1825 天，需要小于等于CrossRetentionValue的值。


异地备份必填
parameters.name: cross_log_retention_value

parameters.help_en:
The instance type. Valid values:
replicate 
sharding

This parameter is required when the backup recovery type is set to rebuilding a deleted instance.
This parameter is required when the backup recovery type is set to cloning an instance from cross-region backup
parameters.help_zh:
实例类型，取值：
replicate 
sharding

当备份恢复类型为已删除实例重建时，需要且必填
当备份恢复类型为异地备份克隆时，需要且必填
parameters.name: instance_type

parameters.help_en:
Specifies whether to enable hourly sparse backup. Valid values:

true: If the backup frequency is set to minutes, all snapshots taken within 1 hour from the current time are retained. For snapshots taken more than 1 hour but within 24 hours from the current time, only the first snapshot taken after the hour is retained.

false: All snapshots taken within the high-frequency backup retention period are retained
parameters.help_zh:
是否开启按小时稀疏备份。

true：当备份频率为分钟级时，距离当前时间1小时内的快照全部保留。距离当前时间超过1小时且在24小时内的快照，仅保留整点后的第一个快照。

false：高频备份保留天数内的快照全部保留
parameters.name: preserve_one_each_hour
